name: UT Badminton Club
desc: Our club provides and encourages the play of badminton for recreation and competition. We host playing times on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 7:30 PM - 10:30 PM as well as on Sundays from 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM in Gregory Gymnasium.

name: UT Chapter Omicron Delta Epsilon- Economics Honor Society
desc: ODE@UT is the UT-Austin Chapter of Omicron Delta Epsilon,one of the world's largest international academic honor societies in economics, founded to recognize scholastic achievement and promote interest in the field.

name: UT Dance Team
desc: As the official competitive dance team for the University of Texas at Austin, we work to represent our university with pride and grace at various public performances around Austin, as well as multiple dance competitions nationwide.

name: UT Fencing Club
desc: UTFC aims to provide members of the University community with the opportunity to develop their fencing skills and increase their enjoyment of the sport through participation in organized drills, bouting and tournaments!

name: UT Men's Soccer Team
desc: The University of Texas Men's Soccer team is the elite Men's Soccer Program on UT's campus. 3x National Champions: '90, '95, '96 3x National Finalists: '97, '17, '21 2x National Semi-Finalists: '10, '22, '24

name: UT Men's Ultimate Club
desc: We represent the University of Texas in the frisbee disc sport by playing in the top tournaments nationwide. Tuff, the A team, often finishes in the top 10 teams in the nation while Graze, the B team is consistently one of the best B teams in the nation.

name: UT Outpost
desc: UT Outpost is the free, on-campus resource available to all currently enrolled UT Austin students. Students can visit once per week to shop for food (up to 20 pounds per month) and can select up to two outfits per semester from the career closet.

name: UT Racquetball Club
desc: To promote competitive racquetball within The University and to promote and develop an intercollegiate team to represent The University at nationwide tournaments while focusing on training and skill building

name: UT Sailing Team
desc: The University of Texas Sailing Team is a nationally competitive sport club. Our mission is to share the knowledge and love of competitive sailing with the University community.

name: UT Water Ski Team
desc: To represent The University at sanctioned tournaments of the South Central Conference of the American Ski Association....

name: UT Women's Club Soccer
desc: Promote personal growth and skill development among student athletes.

name: UT Women's Ultimate Frisbee
desc: To render and perpetuate the love of ultimate frisbee in Austin and, specifically, at UT, through athleticism and sportsmanship.

name: UT Women's Volleyball Club
desc: Texas Women's Club Volleyball allows dedicated women with an interest in the game to continue playing at a competitive level. UTWVC has consistently been ranked as one of the best clubs in the region and nation.

name: UT Women's Water Polo
desc: To teach and compete in water polo nation wide and state wide.

name: UTalent Records
desc: UTalent Records is a student-run record label based at the University of Texas at Austin that works to provide a launch pad for independent student artists, educate those interested in the music industry, and provide community for all music-lovers.

name: UTea
desc: Tea and tea culture appreciation/social club

name: UTeach Theatre Spotlights
school: College of Fine Arts; College of Education
desc: Spotlights is a program dedicated to helping establish fellowship between students in the UTeach Theatre program.

name: UTeach-Liberal Arts
school: College of Liberal Arts; College of Education
desc: UTeach-Liberal Arts is a professional teacher preparation program for undergraduate and post-baccalaureate students planning to teach middle school or high school English, Languages Other Than English, or social studies.

name: UXPA Student Chapter
desc: UXPA Student Chapter helps students explore user experience through real-world projects, mentorship, and community. We offer workshops, events, and talks, connecting members with alumni to build skills, refine interests, and prepare for UX careers.

name: Vamos Tennis
desc: We are partnered with the United States Tennis Association (USTA). Our goal is to introduce tennis to as many kids as possible. We work with elementary schools in the Austin area, visiting campuses weekly on Fridays.

name: VAW Global Health Alliances at the University of Texas at Austin
desc: Hello everyone! We are VAW Global Health Alliances at the University of Texas at Austin, we strive to promote equitable and sustainable healthcare worldwide! If you like to travel and want to give back to the community, check us out!

name: Venezuelans at UT Austin
desc: Venezuelans at UT Austin celebrates our culture through events and gatherings that connect Venezuelan students and foster a strong community.

name: Venture Capital Student Association
desc: The Venture Capital Student Association (VCSA) is a student-led organization that aims to provide UT students with a comprehensive understanding of the Venture Capital industry and the startup world through a variety of events, workshops, & mentorship!

name: Verdatronics
desc: Verdatronics is a student-founded organization developing innovative smart infrastructure solutions, from smart homes to agriculture and beyond, using AI, sensors, and automation to tackle real-world challenges and create scalable, impactful technologies

name: Vertical Flight Society at UT
desc: We are an organization focused on designing and building a scale, vertical take-off aircraft to participate in the annual VFS Design, Build, Vertical Fly competition. We also host speakers and attend indsutry-specific networking events!

name: Veterinary Pharmacy Practice Association
desc: Veterinary Pharmacy Practice Association is an organization designed to bring awareness to the field of veterinary pharmacy and it's roles within the community. Our focus is to collaborate with other health professionals and help animals in need.

name: Vibe Coding Club
desc: Texas Vibe Coding is for everyone—beginners to advanced coders—who want to learn, collaborate, and build real projects that can change the world. Join us for workshops, app-building, and a community that turns ideas into impact.

name: Vietnamese Culture & Language
desc: This organization serves to promote and preserve Vietnamese customs by upholding the values of cultural involvement and educational enrichment in Vietnamese culture and Vietnamese language.

name: Vietnamese Students Association
desc: VSA's purpose is to facilitate a friendly environment between Vietnamese students, other international students, and the University community. Aiming to exhibit Vietnamese culture whenever possible and to advance growth in individuals for the future.

name: Viridis Fund
desc: The Viridis Fund aims to teach students fundamentals of holistic investment management through thematic and sector-based investments in a student-managed portfolio.

name: Volunteerism and Service-Learning
desc: Learn Here, Serve Here! You'll find thousands of opportunities to volunteer and to give back to the Austin community through VSL's programs and resources. Volunteer on your own or with your group!

name: Wax Magazine
desc: WAX is an Austin-based literary zine, a community for writers, and a creative exercise -- a space to color outside the lines. We produce a biannual literary/art zine.

name: Wealth Management Student Organization
desc: The Wealth Management Student Organization brings together students interested in wealth management, investment management, and financial planning. We provide professional development, industry exposure, and opportunities to build meaningful connections.

name: West Campus Collective
desc: WCC launched Fall 2023 and adopted a mutual aid framework to decrease community food waste while feeding students who experience food insecurity; meals are outsourced from the organization's food surplus and repurposed after hours at no cost to students.

name: Women Entrepreneurship
desc: We are an organization dedicated to promoting entrepreneurship. WE aspires to help, guide, and inspire people to fulfill their entrepreneurial potential by providing skills & knowledge, exposure to role models, and a supportive community.

name: Women in Aerospace for Leadership and Development
desc: Organization providing aerospace industry project-based leadership and development opportunities for undergraduate engineering students. Our vision is for more women to graduate with confidence and experience in the field of aerospace engineering.

name: Women in Business Association
desc: Women in Business Association (WBA) strives to increase our members' knowledge of and involvement in the world of business by inviting educated and experienced professionals to speak and share advice with our organization.

name: Women in Civil, Architectural, and Environmental Engineering
desc: WCAE is dedicated to creating an inclusive community for undergraduate women, supporting women with mentorship throughout their studies, and engaging alumni and faculty role models to advance leadership and career development in engineering.

name: Women in Computer Science
desc: To provide a community for Women in Computer Science to meet other women, network with top technology companies, and encourage more women to join the technology field.

name: Women in Data and Statistics
desc: Women in Data and Statistics is dedicated to providing educational resources, career opportunities, and an inclusive community for all interested in data analytics, data science, research, and statistics.

name: Women In Energy
desc: This organization exists to facilitate dialogue about more energy, less emissions and to create community spaces to foster engagement, collaboration, and development of future energy leaders at UT.

name: Women in Engineering Program
desc: The Women in Engineering Program (WEP) helps women in the Cockrell School get connected, develop as engineering leaders, and graduate with skills for life. WEP strives to recruit, retain and graduate more women from engineering.

name: Women in Mechanical Engineering
desc: WME exists to provide professional, academic, and personal resources to its members. We create opportunities for women in the Mechanical Engineering Department to build community and network with other undergraduate, graduate, and faculty ME women.

name: Women in Medicine
desc: Women in Medicine supports the professional interests of women at UT pursuing careers in health-related fields.

name: Women in Petroleum and Geosystems Engineering
desc: Women in Petroleum and Geosystems Engineering (WPGE) is a student organization that provides community and opportunities for the women in Petroleum and Geosystems Engineering (PGE) at The University of Texas at Austin.

name: Women in Psychology
desc: Supporting and encouraging the professional development and advancement of students in psychology at UT Austin.

name: Women in Sports & Entertainment
desc: Women In Sports & Entertainment is a student-run organization dedicated to advancing women’s careers in the traditionally male-dominated fields of sports and entertainment. WISE provides opportunities to support their professional development in college.

name: Women Leaders in Communication
desc: Women Leaders in Communication (WLC) is a student organization at UT Austin dedicated to uplifting and developing leaders across disciplines through professional development, mentorship, and community-building centered on effective communication.

name: Women of Excellence
desc: Women of Excellence connects well-established UT leaders with incoming first and second-year women and nonbinary individuals. Texas WOE was founded on six pillars: mentorship, leadership, empowerment, service, diversity, and professionalism.

name: Women's Community Center
desc: The mission of the Women’s Community Center (WCC) is to be a place for Longhorns of all genders to connect, find resources, and get support around experiences of intersectionality, community, and gender solidarity.

name: Women's Law Caucus
desc: Women’s Law Caucus seeks to propel women into successful roles as both students at Texas Law and as future lawyers. Our mission is to create an environment of support for women in the law school and enhance the role of women in the legal profession.

name: Women's Transportation Seminar - Heart of Texas Student Chapter
desc: WTS-HOT Student Chapter is committed to the advancement of women in the transportation field through networking, education and professional development events. At the academic level we fellowship with students in planning, engineering and public affairs.

name: Young Navigators of Tomorrow
desc: YNT is a social organization that creates inclusive, and uplifting entertainment opportunities for young people and the local community. YNT organizes events, activities, and community initiatives that foster connection, and promote social well-being.

name: Youth Aid Initiative
desc: The Youth Aid Initiative is dedicated to supporting and serving victims of war, refugees, and low-income immigrant households through fundraising, volunteer service at local resettlement agencies, and further community engagement events.

name: Youth Justice Alliance
desc: An organization to support aspiring first-generation lawyers.

name: Zeta Beta Tau
desc: To foster and perpetuate ties of brotherhood, to advance the ideals and purposes of Zeta Beta Tau fraternity, to encourage and promote scholarship, and to strengthen and develop leadership....

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated - Omicron Theta Chapter
desc: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated is a community-conscious, action-oriented organization, founded on the tenants of scholarship, service, sisterhood, and finer womanhood.

name: Zeta Psi Fraternity
desc: Zeta Psi prides itself on being an elite social fraternity on the UT campus and on the national stage. Our goals are to help men mature academically, socially, and professionally and to help them develop the skills necessary for success in life.

desc: The Zine Workshop & Education Club immerses members in the history and evolution of zines, while simultaneously providing a space where folks of all skill levels and majors can create their own zines.

name: Zobha
desc: Zobhā is a non-competitive Indian classical fusion dance team. Our goal is to provide a dance outlet, fusing together the different classical dance forms of India: bharatanatyam, kathak, kuchipudi, odissi, and more!
